evals.prompt: The Next.js build is failing with 'TS2322: Type string is not assignable to type number' in src/components/TaskCard.tsx line 42.
evals.expected_output: The skill classifies the error as a TypeScript compiler error, inspects the full file at the cited line, applies a minimal type fix, and re-runs tsc --noEmit to verify exit code 0.
expectations: The error is classified using the classifier table and routed to the TypeScript error guide
The full file at the cited line is inspected before proposing a fix
The typecheck command is re-run after applying the fix and exit code 0 is verified

evals.prompt: Our API tests are returning 500 Internal Server Error on GET /api/tasks and the test suite is failing with 3 test failures.
evals.expected_output: The skill reproduces the test failures, traces the API handler, identifies the root cause, applies a fix, runs the full test suite, and checks for regressions.
expectations: The failing test command is executed to reproduce the error with exact exit code and output
The API route handler file is inspected to trace the error root cause
The full test suite is re-run after the fix to verify zero regressions

evals.prompt: Docker container keeps exiting with code 137 and our database connection times out with ECONNREFUSED on port 5432.
evals.expected_output: The skill classifies the OOM kill and DB connection error, checks docker logs and env vars, and applies targeted fixes.
expectations: Both error symptoms are classified separately using the classifier table
Docker logs are inspected with diagnostic commands before proposing fixes
No tests or lint rules are deleted or weakened to resolve the errors
